name: JaPoP L&R
note: Scenario judgment on partner vs professional/tool lean. Avoid product-meta stems. Roughly balanced True/False.

items.text: Someone who always answers within an hour, but never starts a thread or brings a next step, is already showing full partner-level proactiveness.
Replying carefully when asked can show integrity and reliability without proving they will volunteer risk or agenda on their own.
If the other person only ever sends 'sounds good' or 'thanks' after your long proposals, that pattern leans more tool-like than partner-like.
A warm friendship of many years is enough evidence that two people will share decision load equally in a company.
When one person invents every idea and the other only executes after being assigned, the second person is still at the top of the partner scale.
Proactiveness here means bringing an idea, risk, or next step without waiting to be tapped - not merely answering faster than usual.
A three-week burst of daily chat followed by six months of silence is stronger partner evidence than a quieter but steady six-month back-and-forth.
Division of labor can be uneven in skills (one codes, one sells) and still be partnerable if both sides initiate and carry decisions in their lane.
If you always have to chase them to get a reply, and they never chase you with an open loop, the chase pattern itself is a partnerability signal.
Saying 'I am a partner type' in a coffee chat outweighs months of one-sided emails where only you follow up.
Someone who pushes back with a dated counter-proposal is closer to partner behavior than someone who always agrees and then goes quiet.
Family relation (siblings, spouses) automatically places both people high on the partner scale for a business venture.
A person who only works when you assign tasks may still be a strong professional hire - that is not the same claim as equal partnerability.
If both sides start threads, reopen stale topics, and propose next steps over months, that reciprocity weighs more than a single inspiring pep talk.
Ghosting after early enthusiasm should be ignored if their personality test said they are collaborative.
Initiative (answering when tapped) without volunteering next moves can still be honest professional behavior - it just is not full partner lean.
Hard work on assigned tasks for a year proves equal partnerability even if they never propose direction or reopen a stalled decision.
